subject.title: fix: prevent session-changed errors after reset

question: Should lifecycle revision become a supported shared session-hook and agent-harness contract for plugins, rather than remaining a Codex-local implementation detail?
rationale: The branch adds exported fields used by core session producers and potentially every plugin/harness consumer. This is an additive but durable API direction that cannot be settled solely from the Codex regression tests.

options.title: Accept the shared lifecycle contract
options.body: Document the intended ownership semantics, retain the additive optional fields, and merge after exact-head real behavior proof.

options.title: Keep it Codex-local
options.body: Redesign the fix so core exposes only an existing generic ownership fact or a narrower Codex seam instead of broadening plugin lifecycle events.

options.title: Pause for API review
options.body: Hold the PR until plugin SDK and session-lifecycle owners decide which contract external plugins should rely on.

recommendation.title: Accept the shared lifecycle contract
recommendation.body: Document the intended ownership semantics, retain the additive optional fields, and merge after exact-head real behavior proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The current retained-ID reset and lifecycle-revision behavior originates in the merged reset-boundary work.
